happeningTypes.name: Prompt scheduled checking and recording of specified goal progress
happeningTypes.description: Ask a person to attend to and record progress against an explicitly specified goal on declared occasions. Identity specifies a prompt, not compliance, efficacy, permission, gap reduction or recommendation.
happeningTypes.constraints: Consent, burden, data minimization and actor/context assessment required; recording can become intrusive or counterproductive. No clinical/practitioner permission.

happeningTypes.name: Practice a specified go/no-go response-withholding task
happeningTypes.description: Repeatedly present specified go and no-go cues with task instructions to respond or withhold respectively. Stimuli, proportion, timing and adaptivity belong to the protocol. Identity promises no general inhibition, behavioral benefit, efficacy or practitioner permission.
happeningTypes.constraints: Consent, accessibility, fatigue/task burden, cue selection and transfer assessment; not a treatment recommendation or permission to manipulate behavior.

assertions.scope: Specified goal-progress prompts versus specified comparator, with actual attended checking/recording measured. Current evidence pools heterogeneous intervention protocols; exact prompt implementation and attention-versus-frequency contrast require extraction.
assertions.measurement: Actual frequency plus attended comparison, not sensor capture, dashboard visibility or goal attainment.
assertions.timing: Observation during declared monitoring period; lag/persistence not yet identified for a specific prompt.
assertions.mechanism: Prompting may increase opportunities for attended comparison; operation and realized process remain distinct.
assertions.risk: Privacy/burden/reactivity; no universal decrease in signed PSY-078 or automatic goal success. RDS recomputes from declared external inputs only.
assertions.rationale: Harkin randomized synthesis supports increased monitoring frequency, but does not isolate this exact prompt/check operation or entire frequency-plus-attention construct. Retain RN rather than importing downstream mediation.

assertions.scope: Repeated specified GNG practice in healthy adults; exact protocol, independent inhibitory-control measurement and active comparator required. No whole-capacity or durable transfer assertion from heterogeneous task scores.
assertions.measurement: Withholding accuracy with speed/accuracy/strategy controls; go RT, Stroop, working memory and food intake are not equivalent indicators.
assertions.timing: Training over days/weeks; immediate and later tests separated; no assumed durable benefit.
assertions.mechanism: Task practice can alter cue-response behavior without improving general response inhibition.
assertions.risk: Task transfer, comparator choice, stimulus-specific learning and fatigue. No inferred self-control resource, trait change or clinical efficacy.
assertions.rationale: Positive pooled cognitive-task outcomes coexist with active-control null and longer-term nondetection. Mixed estimands and proxy mismatch leave exact Driver effect insufficient; no universal null.

findings.population: Sample contexts heterogeneous; exact target prompt not isolated
findings.context: Sample contexts heterogeneous; exact target prompt not isolated
findings.exposure: Interventions designed to increase progress monitoring
findings.result: Monitoring frequency increased on average across randomized protocols.
findings.limitations: Protocol heterogeneity and attention/recording distinction; result supports broader studied intervention class, not exact dose or universal individual effect.

findings.result: Average attainment benefit; monitoring-frequency mediation and public/physical-recording moderators reported.
findings.limitations: OUTSIDE direct PSY-077 target: attainment is downstream; no causal pathway from meta-mediation or signed PSY-078 decrease. Same source/sample contribution.

findings.population: Healthy adults; review language patients not clinical sample
findings.context: Healthy adults; review language patients not clinical sample
findings.measurement: Mixed go RT, GNG RT/IES, Stroop interference, working memory
findings.result: Pooled cognitive scores favorable, highly heterogeneous; SST-alone contrast not significant. Review Table1 selects Enge passive-control contrast.
findings.locator: Methods Statistical Analysis; Table1 and Results; https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC9197126/fullTextXML
findings.limitations: Go-speed/composite cognitive outcomes not independent latent response inhibition. Comparator selection matters; Enge is included, not new replication; SST/combined are OUTSIDE exact standalone GNG identity.

findings.sample: Subset of same trials; followup-specific N not extracted
findings.result: Overall longer-term pooled difference not significant; GNG/SST-alone nondetection; combined subgroup favorable.
findings.locator: Abstract and Results long-term subgroup analysis; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35712455/
findings.limitations: Nondetection not equivalence; combined subgroup differs from overall/standalone GNG and cannot be silently omitted. Unknown current capacity not zero.

findings.exposure: Adaptive GNG plus SST training over3weeks
findings.comparator: Nonadaptive active training; separate passive control
findings.result: No adaptive advantage over active control; passive-control latency advantage does not identify inhibition function gain.
findings.limitations: OUTSIDE exact standalone GNG operation: combined protocol. Critical comparator counterevidence, not proof all GNG ineffective; review reuses passive comparison; no independent replication.

findings.result: Small average health-behavior difference, task and measurement moderation; immediate GNG outcomes stronger.
findings.limitations: OUTSIDE direct PSY-081: changed intake can reflect cue-specific devaluation or associations; review-primary overlap not replication. No practitioner inference.

findings.result: Small average training benefit attenuated by bias correction; weaker against active controls; active mechanism unresolved.
findings.limitations: OUTSIDE exact GNG operation/current PSY-081 capacity. Review does not establish repeated inhibition as critical component or broad transfer; no universal strength resource.
